title: Netflix Announces the Start of Production on 'Jotadé', the Adaptation of Santiago Díaz’s Novel
summary: Isaac Díaz, Aura Garrido, Jose Coronado and Jaime Lorente star in this crime thriller set in Madrid, directed by Daniel Calparsoro
body_markdown:
Entertainment


26 October 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


###


Isaac Díaz, Aura Garrido, Jose Coronado and Jaime Lorente star in this crime thriller set in Madrid, directed by Daniel Calparsoro


[DOWNLOAD THE IMAGES](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/106b6ab9-9d1f-4662-96f0-609aa2ab5a59)


Netflix today announced the start of production on


Jotadé


, a four-episode limited series based on the first novel in the series by Spanish author Santiago Díaz, published by Alfaguara (Penguin Random House Grupo Editorial).


MOD Producciones


is behind the series, with


Fernando Bovaira


serving as producer and


Guillem Vidal-Folch


as executive producer.


The crime thriller stars


Isaac Díaz


as


Jotadé


, alongside


Aura Garrido


(


The Ministry of Time


,


The Innocent


) as


Lucía


,


Jose Coronado


(


The Final Problem


,


The Truthers


) as


Hilario Garza


, and


Jaime Lorente


(


Money Heist


,


Elite


) as


Tony Garza


. The cast also includes


María de Nati


(


Wrong Side of the Tracks


,


The Good Boss


),


Alberto Olmo


(


Montecristo


,


Un lío de millones


),


Melania Cruz


,


Carmen Avilés


,


Moreno Borja


(


One Hundred Years of Solitude


,


Carmen & Lola


),


Rafaela León


(


Carmen & Lola


),


Antonio Zafra


, and


Álvaro Rico


(


The Gardener


,


The Tribute


), with special guest appearance by


Javier Gutiérrez


(


Marshland


,


Champions


).


Jotadé


is an unconventional police officer: brazen and irreverent, yet sharp, sincere, and fiercely loyal to both his colleagues and his Romani community. When he’s assigned to investigate a brutal crime that conceals a dangerous criminal network, he faces an impossible mission for a cop who’s never learned how to go unnoticed.


The limited series is written by


Isa Sánchez


and


Daniel Corpas


, and directed by


Daniel Calparsoro


(


Salvador


,


Bank Under Siege


).


About MOD Producciones


MOD is a film and television production company founded in 2007 by Fernando Bovaira, who has been behind some of the most acclaimed titles in Spanish cinema throughout his career, including


The Others


,


The Sea Inside


(Academy Award® for Best Foreign Language Film),


Sex and Lucia


and


Butterfly


. From the outset, MOD has championed productions that combine cinematic quality with a strong connection with audiences, with films such as


Agora


,


Biutiful


,


Cannibal


,


Family United


,


Cousinhood


and


While at War


.


In television, the production company has developed titles including


Crematorium


,


What the Future Holds


,


La Fortuna


,


Los Farad


and


Las Abogadas


, consolidating its presence in both film and scripted television.


Among its most recent productions are


The Blue Star


, directed by Javier Macipe;


The Champion


, directed by Carlos Therón for Netflix;


Glimmers


, directed by Pilar Palomero and recognized with the Silver Shell at the San Sebastián International Film Festival;


La buena letra


, directed by Celia Rico; and


The Captive


, directed by Alejandro Amenábar, which premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival and became one of the highest-grossing films of 2025.


In 2026, MOD adds


La Fiera


, directed by Salvador Calvo;


Calle Málaga


, directed by Maryam Touzani and starring Carmen Maura;


El último mono


, directed by Joaquín Mazón; and


The Final Problem


, a Netflix series based on the novel by Arturo Pérez-Reverte, to its filmography. Upcoming releases include


El mal padre


, directed by Roberto Bueso and selected for the Official Competition of the San Sebastián International Film Festival, and


Bunker


, an international co-production directed by Florian Zeller.


Paola Vallejo


Senior Publicity Manager
